Alex — really appreciate the clarity. Welcome — excited to partner on this.

Quick response and proposed next steps:
1) Redwood MAP roles (nominated):
   - Ben Carter — Sales lead / MAP owner (I will own timeline and procurement coordination).
   - Laura Bennett — Solutions & GRC liaison (SOC 2 evidence intake, evidence tracker).
   - Evelyn Hart — CS/onboarding lead (POC instrumenting, test data handling).
   - Irene Choi — Data protection lead (technical data handling, DLP/KMS questions).

2) Evidence cadence and format:
   - We prefer a single evidence roster CSV (template attached) plus one supporting doc per item (evidence PDF or screenshots).
   - Suggested cadence: initial evidence batch within 5 business days of MAP start, follow-ups twice weekly until items cleared.

3) Timeline and cadence:

     * Week 0 (this week): kickoff sync, nominate owners, upload initial roster.
     * Week 1: Redwood provides mapped evidence requests and any clarifying questions.
     * Week 2: PrimeMed submits majority of evidence; Redwood completes 80% review.
     * Goal: contract signature by 2026-12-15 (aligns with your target).

4) Meeting: 30-minute sync suggested: Tue 2026-12-01 10:00-10:30 PT. If that works, I will send a Calendar invite with an agenda (owners, deliverables, timeline).

Links: MAP template (Google Drive) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP-PrimeMed

I'll also open a HubSpot MAP record and attach the roster.

Best,
